comment: g7-diary-addon: diary fields of the write / edit form (diary boards only). Row 1: diary date, weather buttons, small Pinned / Secret checkboxes at the end (they replace the template's big option cards, which are hidden on diary boards). Row 2: 7 square category boxes + hint. Values live in _local.form (diary_date, diary_weather, diary_category_id) and go with the save request.
